headword: {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}

definitions.gloss: car insurance; automobile insurance; motor vehicle insurance
definitions.explanation: Insurance that covers damages, liability, and injuries related to motor vehicles. In Japan, this includes both mandatory government insurance and optional private insurance.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}の{更新|こうしん}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to renew your car insurance.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}を{起|お}こしたので、{自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}の{保険料|ほけんりょう}が{上|あ}がってしまった。
examples.english: Because I caused an accident, my car insurance premiums went up.

notes:
In Japan, car insurance is divided into two categories: {自賠責|じばいせき}{保険|ほけん} (compulsory automobile liability insurance, required by law) and {任意|にんい}{保険|ほけん} (optional/voluntary insurance, covering additional damages and liability beyond the mandatory minimum). Most drivers carry both.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to sign up for car insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}を{更新|こうしん}する: to renew car insurance
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}の{保険料|ほけんりょう}: car insurance premium
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{保険|ほけん}の{等級|とうきゅう}: insurance grade/rating class

TYPES:
- {自賠責|じばいせき}{保険|ほけん}: compulsory liability insurance (legally required)
- {任意|にんい}{保険|ほけん}: voluntary insurance (recommended but not legally required)
- {車両|しゃりょう}{保険|ほけん}: vehicle damage insurance (covers your own car)
- {対人|たいじん}{保険|ほけん}: personal liability insurance
- {対物|たいぶつ}{保険|ほけん}: property damage insurance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}: life insurance — covers death and illness
- {火災|かさい}{保険|ほけん}: fire insurance — covers property damage from fire
- {損害|そんがい}{保険|ほけん}: non-life insurance — broader category that includes car insurance
